shifts.summary: The shift was reported as moderate overall, with candidates attempting roughly 69–84 questions well. Reasoning was light but time‑pressed, while math was considered easy to moderate despite some long statements. English featured direct/indirect speech and voice items and was tackled quickly by fast readers. System freezes and timing issues affected performance across sections.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Timing was tight and system lag or freezes reduced the number of attempts; questions were light and not very difficult.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Math questions were long and took extra time, but self‑studied candidates found the section doable.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Fast readers could finish English quickly; the section included direct/indirect speech, voice transformations and synonym‑antonym items.
